ticket: T09 — broaden news acquisition (audit finding R07)
before: three RBI feeds, 30 stories, one institution, one country
after: six registered sources across three jurisdictions; 116 stories

acquired_on_first_poll.rbi_*: unchanged=10 each (conditional GET and dedup working)

sebi.observed: 30 items parsed, ZERO with a usable date
sebi.cause: pubDate is '16 Oct, 2026 +0530' — a real date with a real offset, in a format RFC-822 does not cover. A comma was discarding an entire market regulator
sebi.fix: _DAY_GRANULAR formats in parse_feed_datetime, plus day_granular() so callers know the source stated a DATE and no time of day

pib.observed: parses as RSS, returns 20 items, 0 dated
pib.cause: every <item> carries only <title> and <link> — there is NO date element at all. The Lang=1 endpoint also returns Hindi titles
pib.decision: NOT registered, with the reason recorded in REJECTED_SOURCES. A source that vanishes from a plan looks like one nobody tried

non_feed_sources.observed: the Federal Register, USGS and GDELT do not publish RSS at all
non_feed_sources.fix: seraph/news/json_feed.py — named adapters, no shape-guessing path, and JsonSourceFetcher which reuses the feed fetcher's throttle, conditional GET and item-identity rule

usgs_time.why_it_matters: read as seconds, 1760000000000 is the year 57000

gdelt_length.observed: seendate is '20261017T093000Z' — sixteen characters with the Z, fifteen without
gdelt_length.fix: accept both; pinning one length silently discarded every live timestamp

globe_effect.after: Washington D.C. (-77.03637, 38.89511) appears as the origin of 10 Federal Register events alongside Mumbai — a real foreign-origin node on the real globe

not_claimed: six sources are not world coverage either. PIB (Indian government press) remains unusable for want of any publication time, and GDELT is rate-limited and unregistered.

10 of 12 visible events classify as 'other': the extractor's vocabulary was built for RBI prose and does not yet know trade-action, enforcement or seismic language. That is T11/T12 and it is now visible rather than hidden by a narrow corpus.
USGS coordinates are parsed and carried by the adapter but are not yet used to place a node; the story->event->globe path still places from the registry only.
